vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
manual_feedback: Physical corrections keep the existing RL path. Teach corrections are immediate retractable contextual instructions and supervised examples for context selection.
manual_feedback_ui: Four actions: Shadow/Control, Wrong decision, Settings, Teach; undo in Teach and Settings
manual_feedback_context: bounded full eligible HA context snapshot on every physical/manual or Teach correction; supervised relevance can promote previously unselected entities
manual_feedback_schema: online schema rotation preserves matching feature weights and fixed home-intelligence slots; Teach labels survive compatible schema rotation through semantic overlap matching
manual_feedback_safety: Physical corrections cannot mutate policy during historical training. Teach remains retractable; Control requires qualification, review, freshness and device guards; matched explicit user labels bypass only statistical confidence/support/novelty gates.
desired_teaching: Teach stores authoritative Desired for matching context and also feeds broad supervised context relevance; no direct HA call or artificial acknowledgement reward
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID
button_teaching: Retractable contextual user labels with tolerant analogue matching, hard presence/motion direction boundaries, historical as-of broad-context snapshots and sensor relevance learning
teaching_history: Bounded replay plus indexed as-of sampling for dense radar streams; 31 day windows; <=1000 chart points; exact point inspection
anticipation_simulator: Simulator now isolates anticipation/dispatch semantics from the separate production confidence-gate test; both Python 3.11 and 3.13 CI pass
